default.notes: Visa-free for tourism — the immigration officer normally stamps one month on arrival, extendable at the Immigration Department in Kingstown; bring a return ticket and your accommodation address.

groups.notes: CARICOM nationals are entitled to a definite entry of up to six months under the Revised Treaty of Chaguaramas, provided they can support themselves and have no adverse immigration record.

Not on the visa-exemption list — a visitor's visa must be arranged in advance through a Saint Vincent and the Grenadines mission or an accredited representative; confirm the current requirement with the Immigration Department before booking.

VC.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Vincentian citizens.

TW.notes: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines maintains diplomatic relations with Taiwan, and Taiwanese passport holders are admitted visa-free for one month.

XK.notes: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines does not recognise Kosovo, so Kosovan passports are not covered by the visa exemption — contact the Immigration Department before travelling.
